theory_coordinates.T_fam: famine duration = ln((1-R_star)/(1-R_wake))/rho (regen time between starvation and wake thresholds)
theory_coordinates.dose: famine mortality dose = d0 * T_fam (integrated death risk for an unprotected loner per famine)
theory_coordinates.pd: density protection strength (1 - death multiplier at full crowding)
theory_coordinates.chi_a: chemotaxis strength toward aggregation pheromone A
theory_coordinates.T_r: relay refractory (sets L1 wave period ~ T_e+T_r+few)

design_iterations.why: uniform boom-bust, no spatial structure: hunger sensed on raw R with fast S accumulation bug (S grew unboundedly: emit not pulse-limited); relay fired everywhere
frozen mixed state: dormant towers + starving lawn coexist forever; aggregates ate (pe<1) or lawn survived (d_base too low); no remixing after wake
global R oscillator with no aggregation (rho too fast / d0 too strong -> extinction windows narrow); or towers absorb all mass permanently
advect+diffuse applied in one update could overdraw a cell; clip-to-zero CREATED mass (V mean 0.35->13.9 in 1k ticks). Fixed: sequential conservative updates; conservation test now exact to 1e-16

fed cells with wake-commitment timer Ww>0 disperse (fast diffusion + drift DOWN grad A) and do not eat until settled; prevents towers re-starving in their own grazed halo -> clean global lifecycle emerged

controls.name: no_chemotaxis(chi_a=0)
controls.result: R-H relaxation cycles persist but NO aggregation (aggm_range 0.02) and population crashes to V~0.002 (edge of extinction): top law amplitude requires L2

controls.name: no_relay(a_s=0)
controls.result: same as no_chemotaxis (A is integral of firing, so no relay -> no gradient): population crashes, no aggregation layer

controls.name: no_protection(pd=0)
controls.result: aggregates form but die: V crashes to 0.002; lifecycle amplitude decays -> survival needs density protection

L2.variable: aggregation (aggm rise after famine onset; ncl coarsening)

best.g3_law: period = 0.695/rho + 405 (R2=0.9999); analytic famine slope ln((1-R_star)/(1-R_wake))=0.671 (3.7% off)
best.powerlaw_honesty: cluster sizes span 0.96 decades (<1.5): NOT claimed as power law
